beliefs: f(x) = x + sign(x) for x != 0, and f(0) = -1 [E1]
For positive x, f(x) = x + 1; for negative x, f(x) = x - 1 [E1]
At x = 0, f(0) = -1, which breaks the x + sign(x) pattern (would give 0) [E1]
notes: All sampled points fit x+sign(x) except x=0, which returns -1 instead of 0. I encode the general rule with a special case at 0, flagging the 0 behavior as uncertain since only one point probes it.
